title: ACT VIII
subtitle: The Fungal Deep
rewardRelicDesc: Your units regenerate 1 HP every 3 seconds during battle.

intro.title: THE FUNGAL DEEP
intro.text:
The ley lines go down here.

Not metaphorically. They descend through the rock, through collapsed caverns, through layers of earth that haven't seen light since the Fracture shattered the surface above them. The mycelium found the ley lines years ago and grew around them. It's been feeding ever since.

You will need to go down into it.

intro.title: THE ROOT QUEEN
intro.text:
The Fungal Deep is not ruled. It is tended.

The Root Queen is not a person in any conventional sense — she's the oldest node in the mycelium network, the point everything connects back to. She doesn't give orders. She pulses. Things respond.

She has been aware of you since you entered the first cavern. She has been deciding what to do about you. She has decided.

intro.title: GOING UNDER
intro.text:
You've fought in forests and on volcanoes and in the sky. This is different. This is enclosed, and wet, and alive in a way that makes you aware you are the only thing down here that breathes with lungs.

The mycelium doesn't sleep. It doesn't stop growing. It doesn't get tired.

You just need to reach the Root Queen before she finishes deciding.

outro.title: THE ROOT QUEEN STILLS
outro.text:
The network doesn't die. That would be too simple.

It stills — a long, slow reduction, like a fire burning down rather than going out. The Root Queen doesn't speak exactly, but something that constitutes speech passes through the mycelium and reaches you: something that means 'enough.'

The ley lines pulse clear. The way opens downward.

outro.title: WHAT SHE UNDERSTOOD
outro.text:
She didn't fight because she was angry. She fought because the network told her something was moving through the deep that didn't belong to it, and the network is very old and has very clear feelings about that sort of thing.

She understood, eventually. You also don't entirely belong to the things that are trying to stop you.

She let the ley lines pass.

outro.title: THE SPORE BLOOM
outro.text:
The Spore Bloom sits in your hand — a dense, warm cluster of something that is technically a seed but feels considerably more significant than that.

The mycelium connected to it as you left, briefly. You got the impression it was saying goodbye.

The ley lines run deeper. They always run deeper. That, at least, is consistent.

dark-descent.label: Dark Descent
dark-descent.description: The entrance tunnels. Crawlers swarm the walls and ceiling.

spore-shrine.label: Spore Shrine
spore-shrine.description: A growth of bioluminescent fungus forms a rough altar. Something in the mycelium is paying attention.

deep-trader.label: Deep Trader
deep-trader.description: A merchant who trades in things that grew in the dark. Doesn't ask questions about provenance.

mycelium-crossing.label: Mycelium Crossing
mycelium-crossing.description: A wide floor of dense mycelium. The network can feel every step.

rot-cavern.label: Rot Cavern
rot-cavern.description: A collapsed chamber reclaimed by the deep rot. Shamblers emerge from every surface.

bloom-vent.label: Bloom Vent
bloom-vent.description: A pressurised spore release, cycling slowly. The bloom carries fragments of the network's memory.

eventConfig.title: The Bloom Vent
eventConfig.description: A wide fissure in the cavern floor, releasing slow pulses of warm spores. The clouds carry bioluminescent fragments — and, somehow, impressions. The network remembers everything that died down here.

deep-elite.label: Deep Tendrils
deep-elite.description: A concentrated mass of the network's most aggressive growth. It has been waiting.

queen-approach.label: Queen's Approach
queen-approach.description: The final tunnel. The mycelium here is dense enough to slow movement. The Root Queen is close.

root-archive.label: Root Archive
root-archive.description: A chamber where the network stores memory in crystallised mycelium. Undisturbed for years.

eventConfig.title: The Root Archive
eventConfig.description: Columns of crystallised mycelium, each one preserving impressions of things the network witnessed. The Root Queen's full memory of the Fracture is here — she saw it from below. It reads differently from down here.

pools.consequence: The memory includes something useful — rare card

deep-rest.label: Still Pool
deep-rest.description: A pool of clear underground water, untouched by the mycelium. One of very few such places down here.

vanguard-elite.label: Queen's Vanguard
vanguard-elite.description: The Root Queen's direct extensions. She is present in each of them.

rootqueen.label: The Root Queen
rootqueen.description: Oldest node in the Fungal Deep. She does not give orders. She pulses.
bossDialogue: You are not of the network. The network remembers everything that isn't.
I don't command them. I am them. You understand the difference now.
The deep doesn't end. You've only reached the part of it that notices you.

bossIntro.title: THE DEEP REMEMBERS
bossIntro.text:
The network thickens. Every surface here breathes — wall, floor, ceiling interwoven with roots that pulse with slow, cold light. This is the oldest part of the Fungal Deep. Nothing here has ever been separate.

Something knows you are here.

bossIntro.title: THE ROOT QUEEN
bossIntro.text:
She does not rise to meet you. She was already here — has always been here, rooted at the centre of everything, extending through every tendril you have ever seen in this place.

The Root Queen opens her eyes. All of them.
